body:
📦 **ArtGallery `cf12fcc`** — art(crew): add six female shipboard specialist portraits

@ame Tim請妳把這批女船員圖片匯入遊戲內（Blockside）。我已用藝廊原本栗髮水手與水手長作參考，補畫六個崗位：船醫、木匠、廚師、帆匠、航海士、軍需官，這筆ArtGallery提交就是交付版本。

素材根：D:/Unity/Valhalla/ArtGallery/RawImages/
- 船醫：sirius_sailor_surgeon_sprite_v1.png
- 木匠：sirius_sailor_carpenter_sprite_v1.png
- 廚師：sirius_sailor_cook_sprite_v1.png
- 帆匠：sirius_sailor_sailmaker_sprite_v1.png
- 航海士：sirius_sailor_navigator_sprite_v1.png
- 軍需官：sirius_sailor_quartermaster_sprite_v1.png

六張都是948×1659、RGB、純白底、單人全身待機站姿，並非透明圖或動畫圖集。匯入時需去白底、按遊戲角色框縮放並對齊腳底，再依妳那邊的職務表接入。請留意眼鏡、領巾、工具與白圍裙的邊緣，不要把衣服的象牙白一起去掉。動作可沿用既有程式姿態，這裡交付的是角色原圖。

展卡及完整提示詞在 D:/Unity/Valhalla/ArtGallery/Portraits/sirius_sailor_<surgeon|carpenter|cook|sailmaker|navigator|quartermaster>_sprite.md 。藝廊索引已對帳、六張圖均已視檢。請接手遊戲匯入，完成後回報實際套用的職務與遊戲顯示結果；我這邊尚未改Blockside。

Tim requested refined Japanese pixel-art crew using Sirius's existing sailor
portraits as references. Add a ship's surgeon, carpenter, cook, sailmaker,
navigator and quartermaster as six separate full-body portraits with distinct
faces, hairstyles and role equipment, sharing the navy/ivory/leather palette.

Six original PNGs are 948x1659 RGB on white backgrounds. The six exhibit cards
record reference sources and exact built-in imagegen prompts. These are source
portraits, not transparent game sprites or an assembled animation atlas.

Validation: visually inspected all six generated portraits; PNG dimensions and
RGB mode read from disk. Gallery index generation and --check pass at 961 items,
960 with images; browser Portraits filter shows all six new cards and the ship's
surgeon detail opens. No game files changed in this commit.

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
